knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Fixed wiring is not touched. The area is kept clear and the fault is reported at once.
A defective machine is withdrawn and labelled. Taping and continuing are not acceptable controls.
Keeping liquids away from outlets and equipment is part of the electrical control.

practicalCriteria: Checks the test record and tag of a named machine before use
Inspects cord, plug, casing and guards before switching on, and records the result
Withdraws and labels a simulated defective machine
Routes a lead safely and keeps liquid away from the outlet
passRule: Knowledge checks are a reading check only and are not verified practical competence. Assessor must observe every practical criterion; any failure requires remediation and reassessment.
stopWorkCriteria: A machine with a damaged cord or no current test record is used
Any fixed wiring, switchboard or fitting is opened or moved by the learner
A machine is handled with wet hands
